SELECT ag.team, COUNT(*), COUNT(CASE WHEN t.sla_breached = 1 THEN 1 END),
       ROUND(1.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN t.sla_breached = 1 THEN 1 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 4)
FROM cube_demo.support_tickets t
LEFT JOIN cube_demo.support_agents ag ON ag.agent_id = t.agent_id
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT ag.team, COUNT(*), COUNT(CASE WHEN t.sla_breached = 1 THEN 1 END),
       ROUND(1.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN t.sla_breached = 1 THEN 1 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 4)
FROM cube_demo.support_tickets t
LEFT JOIN cube_demo.support_agents ag ON ag.agent_id = t.agent_id
WHERE ag.team = 'Tier 2' GROUP BY 1

SELECT t.category, COUNT(*),
       ROUND(1.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN t.sla_breached = 1 THEN 1 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 4)
FROM cube_demo.support_tickets t GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT t.priority, COUNT(*), ROUND(AVG(t.resolution_hours), 2),
       ROUND(AVG(t.first_response_minutes), 2)
FROM cube_demo.support_tickets t GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT t.priority AS k,
       COUNT(CASE WHEN t.opened_date >= DATE '2026-01-01' AND t.opened_date < DATE '2026-10-01' THEN 1 END) AS tickets,
       COUNT(CASE WHEN t.opened_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND t.opened_date < DATE '2025-10-01' THEN 1 END) AS tickets_ly,
       SUM(CASE WHEN t.opened_date >= DATE '2026-01-01' AND t.opened_date < DATE '2026-10-01' THEN t.sla_breached END) AS breached,
       SUM(CASE WHEN t.opened_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND t.opened_date < DATE '2025-10-01' THEN t.sla_breached END) AS breached_ly
FROM cube_demo.support_tickets t
GROUP BY 1
HAVING tickets > 0
ORDER BY 1

WITH m AS (
  SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', t.opened_date) AS mth,
         COUNT(*) AS tickets, SUM(t.sla_breached) AS breached
  FROM cube_demo.support_tickets t
  GROUP BY 1)
SELECT strftime(this.mth, '%Y-%m-01') AS month,
       this.tickets, ly.tickets AS tickets_ly,
       this.breached, ly.breached AS breached_ly
FROM m this LEFT JOIN m ly ON ly.mth = this.mth - INTERVAL 1 YEAR
WHERE this.mth >= DATE '2026-01-01' AND this.mth < DATE '2026-10-01'
ORDER BY 1

SELECT t.priority, COUNT(*), COUNT(CASE WHEN t.sla_breached = 1 THEN 1 END),
       ROUND(1.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN t.sla_breached = 1 THEN 1 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 4)
FROM cube_demo.support_tickets t
LEFT JOIN cube_demo.support_agents ag ON ag.agent_id = t.agent_id
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT ag.name, COUNT(*), COUNT(CASE WHEN t.sla_breached = 1 THEN 1 END),
       ROUND(1.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN t.sla_breached = 1 THEN 1 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 4)
FROM cube_demo.support_tickets t
LEFT JOIN cube_demo.support_agents ag ON ag.agent_id = t.agent_id
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
